title: Update a client’s details and preferences
summary: Correct contacts, record preferences and tags, and save a reason for the change.

sections.title: Edit the profile
sections.body:
1. Open **Clients**, choose the person and select **Edit profile**.
2. Check required **Name**. Update **Mobile** and **Email** only when your role permits contacts.
3. Optional details include **Birthday**, **Preferred staff member**, **Preferred services**, **Tags**, **Service preferences** and **How they found you**.
4. Review **Communication preferences** for Email and **Text message (SMS)**.
5. Under **Why are you updating this profile?**, choose the required reason.
6. Select **Save profile** and check the updated record.

Use the country-aware mobile input. Do not remove a country code just to make a saved number look shorter.

sections.title: What the changes mean
sections.body:
Preferred staff and services help the team understand the client; they do not reserve time or guarantee a person’s availability. Tags describe the relationship without changing access or prices.

Clearing a communication channel stops waiting messages for that channel. Checking SMS alone does not create the required consent evidence or override a STOP request. Correcting contact information can invalidate older private links, protecting the client from messages sent to the wrong contact.

sections.title: If the profile cannot be saved
sections.body:
Read the field error and keep your changes while correcting it. If another person updated the profile, reload the latest record and review the correction before saving again. Do not overwrite details you are not allowed to view.

You are asked before discarding unsaved profile changes. If you need a permanent contact correction after making an appointment-only correction in Calendar, return here and save it with a reason.
